The filter uses 0.1 micron absolute filtration, meaning no pore is larger than 0.1 microns, which physically blocks harmful contaminants while allowing clean water to pass through. As water is pushed through these fibers, bacteria, protozoa, cysts, and microplastics are trapped on the outside walls while clean water flows through the center. These hollow fiber membranes are engineered with thicker walls and a smaller inner diameter, making them up to 75% stronger than standard membranes, as tested by the Clean Water Institute of Calvin University (July 2018). This durable construction allows aggressive backwashing to restore up to 98% of the original flow rate, extending the life of the filter up to 100,000 gallons with no cartridges to replace. The included 32 ounce standard pouches are collapsible, reusable, pack down small. Fill directly from lakes, rivers, and streams, even in shallow water sources. This portable water filter is compact, lightweight, and ideal for backpacking, survival kits, and international travel. For safety and quality assurance, every Sawyer Squeeze filter is individually tested three times during manufacturing—once after fiber construction and twice after final assembly—to ensure no harmful pathogens can pass through the sealed system or internal O-rings.
